page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Page number top left, running head centred at the top. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: Horum enim decem nominum quę Goliatho attributa sunt, nullum est quod nó ab reliquis omnibus categoria & genere difcrepet. ut nec in illo: Hector, vir magnus, fortis, bellator, pugnans, interfectus ad Troiam ętate[?] occubuit chlamydatus.
main_text.head: CAP. XXIX.
main_text.p: Q[?]VID? Nónne Categoriæ sunt ordo rerum omnium per genera, species & differentias compositus? Categoriarum disciplina, neque ad res, néque ad rerum ordinem describendum pertinet: quemadmodum vulgò in scholis traditur. sed ad dictiones tantum, & attributiones, & vocabula: ut eorum summa genera illis tanquam certis notis cognosci possint. quoniam (ut superius ex Aristotele docuimus) quicquid de alio dicitur id ex aliqua Categoria sumi, eíque attribui oportet. τὸ ͵ ὑπάρχειν τόδε τισὶ, ἢ τὸ ἀληθεύεσθαι τόδε κατά τῶν τόδε, τοσαυταχῶς λεγέον, ὅσαχῶς αἱ κατηγορίαι διήρηνται[?]. lib. prior. Analyt. 1. cap. 26. Caput autem Dialecticę artis est, ut qua ratione aliud de alio dici & pronunciari possit, demonstret. Itaque dictionum declinatione Categorias immutari constat: cùm tamen ob inflexionem verbi res non immutetur. veluti Iustus, est substantia. Iustitia, est qualitas. Eques substantia est, Equita-

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of "QVID?" is ornamental; the letter is read as Q with [?]. The Greek sentence is printed small and partly worn; its wording after "τόδε" and the final word are uncertain and are marked [?]. The word after "ętate" is marked [?]. The catchword "tus" completes the broken word "Equitatus". The foot line is a duplicate of the catchword and should be ignored: it is not printed text, so the bottom catchword alone is the correct entry. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised. Printed page number 100 at top left; running head DIALECTICAE.
